summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on various proposals, including file-level access delegation in the REST Catalog spec and the deprecation of equality deletes in Iceberg V4. Additionally, there are ongoing efforts to enhance performance through integration with EagerInputFile and migration to Jackson 3.
highlights: File-Level Access Delegation in REST Catalog Spec
Deprecate Equality Deletes in Iceberg V4
Integrate EagerInputFile into the manifest reader
